what: Put salsa node map SwissTables (vendor/salsa/src/graph/nodes.rs Table::groups) and the interned tables (vendor/salsa/src/interned/table.rs groups/hashes) on huge pages: they come from the global allocator (mimalloc, base pages), about 120 MiB at 16 Mi nodes probed at random, and sharding keeps each table under 2 MiB, so a blaze_mem Region per table would stay base pages (huge regions commit base pages below 2 MiB). Carve them from one Region::reserve_huge per Nodes / per interned ingredient (size classes, freed tables reused at the next revision). Group is zero-valid, so graph.rs Zeroed fits outside shuttle. Audit and bound: docs/v2/plan/lanes/hugepages/design.md, speed-of-light.md.
